sanskrit:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः ।
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि ॥ ९-२८॥
iast:
śubhāśubhaphalairevaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanaiḥ
saṃnyāsayogayuktātmā vimukto māmupaiṣyasi 9-28
translation: Thus shall you be freed from the bonds-of-actions yielding good and evil fruits ; with the mind steadfast in the YOGA of renunciation and liberated you shall come unto Me.
